messages:
sam_pm: Quick thread 1: proposing a "migration escrow" flow: when a model is flagged for deprecation, lock a migration escrow that guarantees credits + a 30d rollback window for affected tenants. Goal: speed retirements while reducing customer risk. thoughts?
ethan_eng: sounds useful. need clarity: who triggers escrow? autotrigger from bench delta or manual? and how is rollback implemented (routing switch + cache flush)?
claire_csm: prefer mixed model: auto-trigger for self-serve, manual for enterprise unless contract opt-in. credits tiers: self-serve token (30k), startup invoice $250, enterprise custom. Also need in-console opt-out and sign-off UI for CS.
mike_sre: ops needs: escrow must create a per-tenant routing checkpoint and preserve old model for 30d; implement one-click revert which toggles routing and replays cache warmup. Alerting: page if error-rate >1.5x during migration. Tracing tag: migration.escrow_id=<id>.
ethan_eng: implementation sketch: 1) detection -> create escrow record with phases 2) dry-run 1% 5d (credit applied) 3) ramp 10% 48h 4) canary 100% 1h 5) finalize retire but keep rollback window active for 30d. Pseudocode config as string in PRD.
sam_pm: product gates: - self-serve: auto escrow unless opt-out - enterprise: require CS approval before dry-run - partners: manual only. Comms cadence: notice, 7d, 48h, final 24h.
claire_csm: I'll draft comm templates and escalation for finance. Need a short FAQ for customers about how credits are applied.
mike_sre: runbook: add auto-revert script, synthetic traffic validator, and dashboard for escrow cohorts. Also require audit log entry for legal.
notify-bot: Heads-up: weekly migration window free slots available 2024-07-02T09:00Z 1.
sam_pm: plan: pilot cohort 100 tenants mixed tiers in July. I'll post PRD by Wed and assign owners. locking default thresholds: 6% over 14d for pilot unless data suggests change. :thumbsup:
ethan_eng: will spike routing + rollback proto this sprint.
claire_csm: prepping CS pilot invites.
mike_sre: will prep alert rules and synthetic harness.
sam_pm: closing thread
